correctness.rationale: Differentiation yields J=[[ag,a(1-g)],[1,0]] with P(lambda)=lambda^2-ag lambda-a(1-g). Strict quadratic Jury gives 1-a>0, 1+a(2g-1)>0, 1+a(1-g)>0. At q=-a>1, compatible bounds are 1-1/q<g<(1+1/q)/2, width (3-q)/(2q)>0 exactly q<3; at q=3 they touch uniquely g=2/3. J=[[-2,-1],[1,0]] has J+I=N≠0, N²=0, so J^n=(-1)^n(I-nN). Verified this symbolic characteristic, Jury bounds and Jordan powers independently with SymPy. Ricker F_r(K)=K, F_r'(K)=1-r makes slope threshold r<4 for hyperbolic sink. At a=-1, g=0 or 1 are excluded; nonhyperbolic boundaries not claimed nonlinearly unstable.
